ui.menu.character.name: Name
ui.menu.help.lead: The commands you can use. Type them in the chat, which K opens.
ui.menu.keys.lead: The keys of Cyrodiil RP. The game's own keys work as before.
ui.menu.key.self_wheel: Your own actions: a roll, an emote, your party
ui.menu.key.interaction_wheel: Actions towards whoever stands in front of you: a greeting, a trade, a party invitation
ui.menu.key.accept: Accept an invitation to a party or a trade, shown at the top of the screen
ui.menu.key.close: Close a window or the chat
ui.menu.hint: Q and E or the arrows switch tabs, Esc closes.
ui.menu.dice.lead: Your dice set shows on the dice board and in your rolls. Anyone may pick any set: it is only a look.
ui.menu.key.dice: Open or close the dice board
ui.menu.lore.lead: Your lore card says who your character is. You decide who sees each part of it.
ui.menu.lore.name: Your name
ui.menu.lore.preview: Your card as everyone sees it
ui.menu.lore.preview_none: Nothing on your card is public yet.
ui.menu.key.lore: Open or close your lore card
ui.menu.key.lore_look: Read the lore card of the player in front of you
ui.menu.faction.lead: A faction is a lasting organisation of characters: a guild, a gang, a house or a company. Your character can be in one.
ui.menu.faction.found_fee: Founding costs {fee} gold, taken from what you carry. You become its leader.
ui.menu.faction.found_free: Founding costs nothing. You become its leader.
ui.menu.faction.name: Name
ui.menu.faction.invite_how: To invite a player, press H in front of them, or type /faction invite and their number.
ui.menu.faction.rank_leader: Leads the faction, with every permission.
ui.menu.faction.rank_name_length: A rank's name has {min} to {max} characters.
ui.menu.faction.sole_leader: You are the only leader. Give the leader's rank to another member before you leave.
ui.menu.faction.last_member: You are the last member: leaving dissolves the faction.
ui.menu.sanctuary.lead: Inside the walls of the Imperial City, blood may not be spilled. The Sanctuary keeps the peace there.
ui.menu.sanctuary.off: The Sanctuary is off: nobody is protected in the Imperial City now.
ui.menu.sanctuary.protected: You are in the Sanctuary: {area}. It protects you.
ui.menu.sanctuary.aggressor: You attacked someone in the Imperial City. The Sanctuary does not protect you.
ui.menu.sanctuary.rule.npcs: NPCs and guards inside the walls cannot be hurt: every wound closes at once.
ui.menu.sanctuary.rule.players: Nor can you, until you attack someone, a player or an NPC.
ui.menu.sanctuary.rule.aggressor: Whoever attacks becomes an aggressor: no protection for {minutes} min after the last attack, or until death.
ui.menu.sanctuary.rule.bounty: An aggressor gets a bounty of {bounty} gold, and the guards go after them.
ui.menu.sanctuary.rule.victim: The one attacked keeps the protection, unless they strike back.
ui.menu.sanctuary.rule.arena: The Arena is not part of the Sanctuary, and the Sanctuary brings nobody back to life.
